ai_lift.interpretation: rule-based planner versus fixed payment-link baseline; both use the same governed policy

learning_lift.interpretation: learning agent versus the hand-written rulebook, same governed policy and same hidden world. Negative regret delta means the learner chose better actions.

share_of_attainable_value.note: Fraction of the oracle's recovered revenue captured. The oracle has full knowledge of the hidden world and is not achievable; it bounds the scoreboard.

disclaimer: Recovery outcomes are produced by a seeded simulation whose conversion priors were chosen by the authors. These numbers demonstrate that the control system behaves correctly at batch scale. They are NOT a prediction of real-world recovery rates.
